name: command-immutable-arguments
objective: Enforce Command runtime immutability and structured argv invariants at construction and through fluent methods. Executable must be a string (non-string: TypeError; blank string: existing ValueError). arguments must be a tuple of strings; lists, scalar strings and non-string members must raise TypeError. Preserve literal empty/Unicode/whitespace/shell-looking arguments, order, immutable fluent updates, cwd/timeouts and all valid behavior. Do not change tests or execute commands.
